title: Citation share dropping — 14 comparison queries cite competitors only
narrative: Consolidation and template work ship first so the new pages land on clean ground. Drafts go to editors unpublished — Realify writes, a human decides.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 pushed · 12 line items staged

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

items.name: Guide template · sized and preloaded hero
items.detail: Width and height attributes on the hero image plus a preload hint. The only change to the template in this release.

items.name: FAQ and Article schema
items.detail: Generated from existing headings and body content on 40 guide pages. No new copy, no duplicated text.

items.name: Internal links to orphaned guides
items.detail: Two contextual links each into the eight guides that were discovered and never crawled, from pages that already rank.

items.name: Consolidate 3 cannibalisation pairs
items.detail: The weaker page of each pair 301s into the stronger one, with canonicals set to match. Runs before any new page ships.

items.name: Flatten 9 redirect chains
items.detail: Every chain resolves to a single hop. Three of them were three deep on guide URLs.

items.name: Resolve 4 duplicate canonicals + regenerate sitemap
items.detail: The four duplicates are why those pages were never indexed. The sitemap picks up the eight orphaned guides at the same time.

targets.name: Editorial workflow · drafts, not publishes
targets.meta: 3 items · CMS drafts assigned · nothing goes live from here

items.name: Carbon steel vs cast iron · full draft
items.detail: Nine-row comparison table, sourced weight and heat-retention figures, answer-first headings. Enters the CMS unpublished with the brief and source list attached.
items.after: draft with J. Okafor · due Oct 4

items.name: Lead-removal rewrite · full draft
items.detail: States the certification number in text with a reduction percentage per contaminant. Legal review flagged on the draft because it is a compliance claim.
items.after: draft with M. Reyes · legal flag

items.name: Brand-voice and source checklist
items.detail: Attached to both drafts. An editor cannot mark a page ready until every comparison row has a source and the voice items pass.

targets.name: Citation Tracker · monitoring config
targets.meta: weekly per cluster · 3 decay watches armed

items.name: Per-cluster rank and citation reads
items.detail: Weekly pass across 412 queries, split by cluster and intent tier, with the 14 competitor-only queries marked as the primary set.

items.name: Traffic quality read at 14 and 28 days
items.detail: Conversion rate, assisted revenue and bounce on organic entrances to each new page, against the site baseline.

items.name: Decay watches
items.detail: Citation loss, rank slide and quality shortfall each re-open this card with the read attached rather than filing a separate report.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a decay watch re-opens this card and waits for you.
